solver_diagnostics.count_definition: K[group,t] = sum of original binary status variables over devices
solver_diagnostics.storage_headroom_proof: For t>=1, SOC dynamics and SOC bounds imply the charging/discharging headroom bounds in each binary mode; in the other mode the corresponding nonnegative power is zero. At t=0 the original model has no dynamics, so no headroom inequality is added.
